Application developed by Iago Blanco Cañás.

During the game, two constructions will be shown as images. One of them has its height indicated, but the other does not. Your goal is to choose which of the two constructions you think is taller.

To do this, simply tap the image you consider correct. The hidden height will then be revealed.

- If you selected the taller construction, the game continues and another different image will appear.

- If not, the game ends.

At the top right, your current streak and your record are displayed.
